title: Staggered Feature Launch Orchestrator & KPI Runway
description: Working orchestrator doc for a staged rollout of a medium-risk product change (model update + routing policy + new caching). Focus: minimize cost/regression while enabling telemetry-driven ramp. This is intentionally operational/stepwise (not the PRD).
launch_objectives: Validate quality parity vs baseline across high-traffic routes (<=1.5% regression on top-level correctness signals)
Keep 95th percentile latency within 1.2x of current production during each wave
Avoid >5% spike in per-token cost for more than one wave
Collect distributed evaluation data (promptsets by cohort) to confirm no demographic regressions
waves: Wave 0 — internal-only: 3 teams (eng/runtime, se, cs) for smoke + chaos test — 2 hours
Wave 1 — alpha customers (5 low-risk accounts, region: us-west) — 2% traffic cap for 24 hours
Wave 2 — targeted cohorts (early-adopters + beta customers, us-west + eu-north) — 10% traffic cap for 72 hours
Wave 3 — broad ramp (70% target routes, regional throttles, fallback policies active) — progressive 3-day ramp to 50% of total traffic
Wave 4 — full cutover (monitor for 48 hours with prolonged guardrails)
gating_criteria: Functional smoke pass: end-to-end happy-path tests green in Wave 0
Quality gate: rolling average of eval score delta <= 1.5% negative vs baseline over 1,000 samples
Latency gate: P95 latency <= 1.2x baseline AND error rate <= baseline + 0.2%
Cost gate: estimated per-token cost delta <= 5% on sampled traffic
Observability gate: all new spans/traces ingesting and visible in Console within 60s
Fallback verification: automatic fallback to previous model variant succeeds within 15s for injected failures
kpi_targets: User-visible correctness (eval harness score): >= 98.5% of baseline
Cost per 1k tokens: no more than +5%
Model rollout rollback probability: < 10% across first week
Data collection coverage: >= 95% of requests include telemetry labels for cohort, promptset, model-variant
monitoring_playbook: Pre-launch: run synthetic traffic profiles (short/long sequences, edge prompts) through staging for 12 hours
During Wave: operator watches 'launch-ops' dashboard with stream of top 20 slow endpoints and top 10 error traces
Alerting: P95 latency alert (urgent), error rate alert (urgent), eval-regression alert (non-urgent but paged to PM)
Escalation path: Operator -> Oncall SRE -> Runtime lead -> Product Ops -> Exec (if unresolved in 30 min)
Immediate rollback: change routing policy to previous model variant, disable caching experiment, and open incident ticket
contingency_plans: Soft-fallback: route traffic to 'compatible-variant' with lower capacity draw but same interface
Traffic-shed: implement region-level throttles if P95 > 2x baseline and error rate spikes
Model-binary rollback: automated traffic switch to prior model deployed in 3 control-plane steps (can be executed in <90s)
Read-only fallback: temporarily disable mutable features (memories, tool-calls) if causal failures observed
Capacity buffer: reserve one Dedicated cluster for burst absorb (contact infra to enable within 10 minutes)
Customer communication template: pre-drafted note for CS to inform affected customers of rollback and next steps

retrospective_hypotheses_template: Hypothesis: The staged ramp reduces regression surface by isolating cohort-specific prompts
Data required: per-cohort eval deltas, per-route latency percentiles, incident timeline
Success metric: if per-cohort regressions are <1% and no more than one rollback required
Action: If hypothesis false, enhance routing granularity and expand prompt-level guardrails
